name: Hold Bot
description: Bot that plays the level only while you hold the screen.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: <cy>Off</c> - nothing. <cy>Record</c> - records your inputs, saved when you beat the level. <cy>Hold Play</c> - the bot plays the saved macro only while you hold the screen.

need-hold.name: Require Holding
need-hold.description: In Hold Play: bot works only while your finger is on the screen. Turn off for a normal full-auto playback.
